notes.title: New Game Announcement – Infinite Cards!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
I’m excited to share that my next game, [b]Infinite Cards[/b], is now live on Steam. You can wishlist it right now!
[/p][p]It’s a roguelike deckbuilder with infinite unique cards, deep strategy, and fully flexible deck building.
Wishlist here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833300/Infinite_Cards/"][/dynamiclink]If you’ve enjoyed Dungeon Wizards or Ogo, there’s a good chance you’ll like this one too. It’s packed with strategic choices and fun combos.[/p][h1]
Discord Server![/h1][p]Also, I’ve launched a Tubby Turtle Studios Discord Server!
There you’ll find updates on Infinite Cards, plus places to chat about Dungeon Wizards, Ogo, and all upcoming games.[/p][p]
Join the Discord here: https://discord.gg/vhxWQVKsgv
[/p][p]Thanks so much for playing and supporting my games, it really means a lot!
Tubby Turtle[/p]

notes.title: New GameMode: Challenges!
notes.content:
[b]BIG UPDATE
New Game Mode: Challenges![/b]

Added 8 unique challenges where you have to complete a goal to win the game! 
Every challenge comes with modifications that changes the game behaivior.

For example, you have to survive a certain number of enemies, but no potions will spawn!
Or you have to use a certain number of spells, but each time a spell is used, it is replaced with another random spell!


[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Game Mode Challenges.
- 8 Challenges are now available, unlocked with player level.
[*] Added touch controls for SteamDeck
[*] the current gamemode is now called "Endless"
[*] Achievements:
- Added 3 new Achievements for Chalenges.
- Rewrite description of some old Achievements, because most Achievements are only unlockable in Endless game mode.
[*] With the addition of challenges, you have now 2 different Savegames. One for Endless and one for Challenges. So you can try a challenge without having to finish your Endless run!
[*] The "Continue" button in the main menu will continue your last played savegame. To continue a specific GameMode, select the GameMode and click on the continue buttom on the bottom.
[*] Menu navigation changes:
[*] Main menu changes:
- Renamed "New Game" button to "Endless"
- Added a "Challenge" button. 
- Removed "Tutorial" button 
[*] Endless menu changes:
- Renamed "Game Settings" in "Endless"
- Added Tutorial button (the tutorial is now also active by default for the first game)
- Reordered Unlockables-Button. 
- Renamed "Start" Button to "New Game".
- Added a "Continue" Button on the bottom
[*] Other menus changes:
- Added the Unlockable Button in Collection and Challenge Menu.
[*] Slightly modified tutorial text.
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes V1.0.5 / 22.03.2022:
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the game to softlock when restarting the game in the same turn by getting a Runes Up while all spells were already maxed.
Affected savegames work again.

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0.4 / 08.03.2022:
notes.content:
- The game icon in the taskbar is now displayed correctly.
- Tooltip of the boss Poison Snake now shows the correct percentage (4% instead of 8%). 
- Fixed some typos in english tooltips

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.0.3 / 14.02.2022:
notes.content: - Visual Bug Fix: Incorrect class/player level was sometimes displayed in the GameOver screen when the maximum level was reached

notes.title: Patchnotes 10.02.2022 - QoL & Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Added total attack value count for enemies every turn
- If you take damage, the HP bar flashes and it plays a damage sound effect 
- Adjusted tile hitboxes to make diagonal matching work better
- Matching Sound is now pitched on larger chains
- Fixed a bug where the ingame achievement system was sometimes overlapped by other overlays
- Fixed a bug where tiles could not be matched in rare cases 
- Fixed a bug where the eye button to turn transparent worked incorrectly in rare cases
- Stability improvements
